verdict.rationale: Square documents a Subscriptions API and says it can securely save recurring payment methods, alongside an Invoices API, so recurring billing exists at the core. But the evidence is only titles and a marketing line, with no detail on how billing works. The community post only asks whether subscriptions exist and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: evidence of plan definitions, free trials, plan upgrades/downgrades, proration handling, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
